gloss: nape of the neck; back of the neck

definitions.gloss: nape of the neck; back of the neck
definitions.explanation: The area at the back or side of the neck, from the base of the skull down to the shoulders.

examples.japanese: {首筋|くびすじ}に{汗|あせ}をかいた。
examples.english: I broke out in sweat on the back of my neck.

examples.japanese: {冷|つめ}たい{風|かぜ}が{首筋|くびすじ}に{当|あ}たって{寒気|さむけ}がした。
examples.english: The cold wind hit the back of my neck and I felt a chill.

examples.japanese: {日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}めを{首筋|くびすじ}にも{忘|わす}れずに{塗|ぬ}ってください。
examples.english: Don't forget to apply sunscreen to the back of your neck as well.

notes:
COMPOSITION:
{首|くび} (neck) + {筋|すじ} (line, sinew). Literally the "line of the neck," referring to the exposed area at the back and sides.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {首筋|くびすじ}に{触|ふ}れる (to touch the nape)
- {首筋|くびすじ}が{寒|さむ}い (the back of the neck is cold)
- {首筋|くびすじ}に{汗|あせ}をかく (to sweat on the back of the neck)
